It has been designated as a national park since 2002. It is 35 km2 (14 mile²) in area, and located in the municipalities of Loon op Zand, Heusden, and Vught.
The Loonse en Drunense Duinen consists of forests and very large dunes, creating an extraordinary microclimate.
